dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| where isnotempty(['value'])
| extend TimeGenerated = now()
| extend ObservableValue = tostring(['value'])
| extend indicatorType = tostring(['type'])
| extend articleUrl = strcat('https://feedly.com/i/entry/', tostring(['source_entry_id']))
| extend articleTitle = tostring(['source_entry_title'])
| extend sourceName = tostring(['source_name'])
| extend indicatorSubType = tostring(['subtype'])
| extend ObservableKey = case(
    indicatorType in ('ipv4-addr', 'ipv4'), 'ipv4-addr:value',
    indicatorType in ('ipv6-addr', 'ipv6'), 'ipv6-addr:value',
    indicatorType in ('domain-name', 'domain'), 'domain-name:value',
    indicatorType == 'url', 'url:value',
    indicatorType in ('email-addr', 'email'), 'email-addr:value',
    indicatorType in ('md5', 'MD5'), 'file:hashes.MD5',
    indicatorType in ('sha1', 'SHA-1', 'sha-1'), "file:hashes.'SHA-1'",
    indicatorType in ('sha256', 'SHA-256', 'sha-256'), "file:hashes.'SHA-256'",
    strcat(indicatorType, ':value'))
| extend patternValue = replace_string(replace_string(ObservableValue, @"\", @"\\"), "'", @"\'")
| extend Pattern = strcat("[", ObservableKey, " = '", patternValue, "']")
| extend ValidFrom = now()
| extend ValidUntil = datetime_add('day', 90, now())
| extend Created = now()
| extend Modified = now()
| extend IsActive = true
| extend IsDeleted = false
| extend Revoked = false
| extend Confidence = toint(80)
| extend SourceSystem = 'Feedly'
| extend LastUpdateMethod = 'Feedly CCF'
| extend idSeed = strcat(ObservableKey, '|', ObservableValue, '|', tostring(['source_entry_id']))
| extend idPad1 = strcat('0000000000000000', tostring(abs(hash_sha256(idSeed))))
| extend idPad2 = strcat('0000000000000000', tostring(abs(hash_sha256(strcat(idSeed, '|stix')))))
| extend idHex = strcat(substring(idPad1, strlen(idPad1) - 16, 16), substring(idPad2, strlen(idPad2) - 16, 16))
| extend Id = strcat('indicator--', substring(idHex, 0, 8), '-', substring(idHex, 8, 4), '-', substring(idHex, 12, 4), '-', substring(idHex, 16, 4), '-', substring(idHex, 20, 12))
| extend AdditionalFields = bag_pack('articleUrl', articleUrl, 'articleTitle', articleTitle, 'source', sourceName, 'subtype', indicatorSubType, 'stixIdHex', idHex)
| extend Data = bag_pack('type', 'indicator', 'spec_version', '2.1', 'id', Id, 'created', Created, 'modified', Modified, 'name', articleTitle, 'description', strcat('Source: ', sourceName, '. Article: ', articleUrl), 'indicator_types', pack_array('malicious-activity'), 'pattern', Pattern, 'pattern_type', 'stix', 'valid_from', ValidFrom, 'valid_until', ValidUntil, 'labels', pack_array(indicatorSubType))
| project TimeGenerated, Id, ObservableKey, ObservableValue, Pattern, SourceSystem, Confidence, IsActive, IsDeleted, Revoked, ValidFrom, ValidUntil, Created, Modified, LastUpdateMethod, AdditionalFields, Data
